integrity: Exact arithmetic identities and a standalone numerical consistency script are provided. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-dimensional nilpotent Jordan-chain class, fixed number of iterates and fixed step while stiffness tends to infinity; not a claim of uniform convergence or all-method optimality. The post-threshold ETD2 inverse-stiffness coefficient is proved by the leading multinomial term. The numerical script checks finite examples; the infinite assertions are proved analytically.
title: Nilpotent-depth stiff-limit barriers for diagonal-Schur exponential time stepping
